technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish MACD/PPO crossovers and supertrend support, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CPRT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 64 days creating near-term event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling by junior member 137 days ago; market fear (44 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (459.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent FOMC event in 1 day, and 64-day earnings window create a highly adverse macro backdrop for CPRT trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO bullish crossovers and supertrend support offer technical momentum entry near 28.81 support in a fear-driven market that historically rewards contrarian positioning.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA) and Ichimoku cloud with zero fundamental conviction, imminent FOMC event, VIX crisis, and earnings risk in 64 days create an unfavourable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (MACD/PPO crossovers, supertrend) offers entry near support at 28.81 in a fear-driven market. However, fundamental weakness, imminent FOMC event, VIX crisis, and 64-day earnings window create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent FOMC decision (1 day) combined with VIX crisis (459.2) and earnings event risk in 64 days creates binary event risk; price trapped below all major moving averages signals weak underlying structure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical momentum insufficient to overcome macro headwinds and fundamental vacuum
decision.portfolio_note: Already 39 positions in Industrials (14% of portfolio); sector concentration argues against entry despite technical setup.
